parameters.query:
insert into public.events (
  slug,
  status,
  title,
  summary,
  description,
  source_url,
  source_name,
  source_event_id,
  event_start_at,
  event_end_at,
  timezone,
  venue_name,
  venue_address,
  neighborhood,
  category,
  price_text,
  image_url,
  reason,
  suggestion,
  score,
  tags
)
values (
  {{$json.slug || $json.title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 80)}},
  'pending',
  {{$json.title}},
  {{$json.summary || ''}},
  {{$json.description || ''}},
  {{$json.source_url}},
  {{$json.source_name || ''}},
  {{$json.source_event_id || ''}},
  {{$json.event_start_at}},
  {{$json.event_end_at || null}},
  {{$json.timezone || 'Asia/Kolkata'}},
  {{$json.venue_name || ''}},
  {{$json.venue_address || ''}},
  {{$json.neighborhood || ''}},
  {{$json.category || 'General'}},
  {{$json.price_text || ''}},
  {{$json.image_url || null}},
  {{$json.reason || ''}},
  {{$json.suggestion || ''}},
  {{$json.score || null}},
  {{$json.tags || []}}
)
on conflict (slug)
do update set
  title = excluded.title,
  summary = excluded.summary,
  description = excluded.description,
  source_url = excluded.source_url,
  source_name = excluded.source_name,
  source_event_id = excluded.source_event_id,
  event_start_at = excluded.event_start_at,
  event_end_at = excluded.event_end_at,
  timezone = excluded.timezone,
  venue_name = excluded.venue_name,
  venue_address = excluded.venue_address,
  neighborhood = excluded.neighborhood,
  category = excluded.category,
  price_text = excluded.price_text,
  image_url = excluded.image_url,
  reason = excluded.reason,
  suggestion = excluded.suggestion,
  score = excluded.score,
  tags = excluded.tags;
